title: Semi-rational evolution of a recombinant DNA polymerase for modified nucleotide incorporation efficiency.
authors: Zhai, Lili; Wang, Zi; Liu, Fen; Xu, Chongjun; Wang, Jingjing; Han, Hongyan; Xie, Qingqing; Zhang, Wenwei; Zheng, Yue; Buell, Alexander K; Dong, Yuliang
one_liner_zh: 该文通过半理性进化改造B家族DNA聚合酶以高效掺入修饰核苷酸，结合计算模拟预测DNA结合区突变，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作和计算模拟，但核心是酶工程而非TF-DNA转录因子结合机制，方法可迁移但对象偏离。
abstract: Engineering improved B-family DNA polymerases to catalyze 3'-O-modified nucleotide reversible terminators is limited by an insufficient understanding of the structural determinants that define polymerization efficiency. To explore the key mechanism for unnatural nucleotide incorporation, we engineered a B-family DNA polymerase from Thermococcus Kodakaraenis (KOD pol) by using semi-rational design strategies. We first scanned the active pocket of KOD pol through site-directed saturation mutagenesis and combinatorial mutations and identified a variant Mut_C2 containing five mutation sites (D141A, E143A, L408I, Y409A, A485E) using a high-throughput microwell-based screening method. Mut_C2 demonstrated high catalytic efficiency in incorporating 3'-O-azidomethyl-dATP labeled with a Cy3 dye, whereas the wild-type KOD pol failed to catalyze it. Computational simulations were then conducted of the DNA binding region of KOD pol to predict additional mutations with enhanced catalytic activity, which were subsequently experimentally verified. By a stepwise combinatorial mutagenesis approach, we obtained an eleven-mutation variant, named Mut_E10 by introducing additional mutations to the Mut_C2 variant. Mut_E10, which carried six specific mutations (S383T, Y384F, V389I, V589H, T676K, and V680M) within the DNA-binding region, demonstrated over 20-fold improvement in enzymatic activity as compared to Mut_C2. In addition, Mut_E10 demonstrated satisfactory performance in two different sequencing platforms (BGISEQ-500 and MGISEQ-2000), indicating its potential for commercialization. Our study demonstrates that a significant enhancement in its catalytic efficiency towards modified nucleotides can be achieved efficiently through combinatorial mutagenesis of residues in the active site and DNA binding region of DNA polymerases. These findings contribute to a comprehensive understanding of the mechanisms that underlie the incorporation of modified nucleotides by DNA polymerase. The sites of beneficial mutations, as well as the nucleotide incorporation mechanism identified in this study, can provide valuable guidance for the engineering of other B-family DNA polymerases.
abstract_zh: 工程化改进B家族DNA聚合酶以催化3'-O修饰核苷酸可逆终止子的应用，受限于对决定聚合效率的结构决定因素理解不足。为探索非天然核苷酸掺入的关键机制，我们采用半理性设计策略，对来自Thermococcus Kodakaraenis的B家族DNA聚合酶（KOD pol）进行了工程化改造。首先，通过定点饱和突变和组合突变扫描KOD pol的活性口袋，并利用基于微孔板的高通量筛选方法，鉴定出一个包含五个突变位点（D141A、E143A、L408I、Y409A、A485E）的变体Mut_C2。Mut_C2在掺入带有Cy3染料的3'-O-叠氮甲基-dATP时表现出高催化效率，而野生型KOD pol则无法催化该反应。随后，对KOD pol的DNA结合区域进行了计算模拟，以预测具有增强催化活性的额外突变，并通过实验验证。通过逐步组合突变策略，我们在Mut_C2变体基础上引入额外突变，获得了一个含十一个突变位点的变体，命名为Mut_E10。Mut_E10在DNA结合区域内携带六个特异性突变（S383T、Y384F、V389I、V589H、T676K和V680M），其酶活性相比Mut_C2提高了20倍以上。此外，Mut_E10在两个不同测序平台（BGISEQ-500和MGISEQ-2000）上表现出令人满意的性能，表明其具有商业化潜力。我们的研究表明，通过对DNA聚合酶活性位点和DNA结合区域残基进行组合突变，可以有效实现对其修饰核苷酸催化效率的显著提升。这些发现有助于全面理解DNA聚合酶掺入修饰核苷酸的机制。本研究中鉴定的有益突变位点及核苷酸掺入机制，可为其他B家族DNA聚合酶的工程化改造提供宝贵指导。
